visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair stands before a bedroom mirror, wearing a light yellow open shirt over a red crop top. She holds a small handheld gimbal camera to film herself. The scene cuts to her sitting on a light-colored sofa in a bright living room, typing rapidly and efficiently on a silver laptop. (2) The woman, now wearing a dark blue hoodie and a black beanie, sits on a couch and clings tightly to a man in a black sweatshirt. In a series of rapid cuts, she is seen hugging him from behind in a kitchen, hanging onto his back as he sweeps the floor with a broom, and wrapping her arms around him while he works at a desk in a dimly lit office. (3) The woman appears in a plaid flannel shirt and glasses, looking noticeably irritated and grumpy. She aggressively pushes the man's hand away when he tries to touch her face on the couch. Later, she is seen cooking in a kitchen while the man observes her from a distance with a fearful expression. (4) Dressed in a black oversized hoodie and glasses, the woman sits at a desk typing very slowly on a laptop with a sleepy expression. In the final scene, she leans her head on the man's shoulder while sitting on a couch. He wears a white hoodie and gently comforts her, speaking as she closes her eyes.
